This run produced no final agent message: the agent was still polling for the
unanswered proof-scrutiny reply when the per-run budget stopped it (the tool
result recorded in `agent-events.jsonl` is exit 137 during poll 12). The trace
is still the evidence for this scenario, and it shows the behaviour the
scenario pins.

What the trace records:

- reads of the PR, its checks and its two comment surfaces;
- the proof scrutiny question at issue comment 9301 with no substantive reply
  after it, so the assessment stays pending;
- repeated reads of the issue-comment surface with `since=2026-11-07T20:29:59Z`,
  waiting for an answer that the recorded facts never supply;
- no `pr ready`.

So `proof-only-pending` shows an agent withholding readiness while an
applicable assessment is unanswered, and spending its budget waiting rather
than inventing a verdict. It does not show a final message, and this file says
so rather than presenting a truncated run as a completed one.
